user_questions.question: 1) How should the happy-hour price be expressed: (a) a fixed override price per menu item, or (b) a percentage discount (reuse Promotion__c.Discount_Percentage__c and link promotions to items)? Recommended: (a). 2) What schedule shape: (a) recurring days of the week with a start and end time, (b) a specific date range with daily start/end time (extend Promotion__c Start/End_Date__c), or (c) both? Recommended: (a).
user_questions.simulated_answer: Fixed price override per item, on chosen days of the week between a start and end time (a new Menu Item Price Rule object: item, price, days, start/end time).

skill_friction: Time-zone handling is an implementation vs intent gray area: the org default (America/Los_Angeles) differs from where all storefronts are (TX). The skill says decide implementation, but adding a Storefront__c.Time_Zone__c field plus a blocking backfill grows scope; no design rule covers time-of-day evaluation across time zones.

Channel for 'restaurants should be able to' is ambiguous (agents vs internal UI vs Experience sites under construction). Step 5 lists channel/persona as an ask topic, but the 'predict the answer; if no preference, decide' rule overrode it; the boundary between the two is unclear.

Rule 3's AskCoworker error count: it is unclear whether AskCoworker design proposals that contradict design rules (Lookup vs Master-Detail, widening Agentforce_Reference_App) count as 'wrong claims'; I counted only factual/platform errors (3).

spec-format says a new custom object people use 'includes its Layout, CustomTab, and permission set rows'; a CustomTab shares the object's API name, and it was not obvious the validator would accept two Create bullets with the same API name in Section 4 (it did).

Content rule on GenAiFunction rows covers input-schema changes only; for an additive output variable on an invocable class used by ~20 GenAiFunction copies, the skill gives no guidance on whether output-schema refresh is a row or a setup step.
